_comment: turn-pipeline.md — pending tool calls are always dispatched, regardless of what status claims. A model can (wrongly) pair status:"done" with a real tool call in the same step (report_status(done) alongside e.g. create_intention); turn.go's stop/continue check looks at ToolCalls FIRST and only consults status once nothing is pending, so this still dispatches instead of being silently dropped. Regression for a real bug found via a live reminder request whose create_intention call was minted into tool_calls (status=pending) and then discarded because status alone gated the stop decision.
